topic: Can we create an environmentally friendly replacement for plastics?
scientific_reframe: For a defined product function and service lifetime, when do bio-based or biodegradable polymers reduce life-cycle greenhouse-gas emissions, fossil-resource use, persistent pollution, and human-health burden relative to a conventional plastic, while retaining required mechanical, barrier, safety, and end-of-life performance?
